text:
When you fall mute,

when I go blind,

we will have our hands

and silence.


When you grow old,

when I grow old,

we will have farewells

and silence.


When you are dead,

when I am dead,

they will have to bury us together

and in silence;


and when you rise again,

when I live anew,

we will love each other again

in silence.


When everything ends

forever in the Universe,

it will be a silence of love,

silence.

translation.title: Silence
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the simple parallel movement from bodily loss to cosmic love-silence.
